integrity: Finite counts checked by an independent exhaustive ballot/IRV implementation through seven voters; asymptotics proved analytically; no independent scientific audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three candidates, fixed axis, odd electorate, independent uniform over four single-peaked ballots.
Failure means every legal first-round tie-breaking selection rejects the Condorcet winner; conditional tie-breaking outcomes are excluded.
The underlying deterministic center-elimination situation is known; only the exact finite risk and residue-sensitive asymptotic are assessed here.
Full bibliographic uniqueness is not independently established.
title: Exact and residue-sensitive asymptotic probability of ranked-choice center squeeze
